sentences.en: Once you start dating the sleazy old professor, disillusionment sets in.
sentences.zh: 一旦你开始和那个花言巧语的老教授交往，幻灭感就会随之而来。

sentences.en: The idealism of youth often leads to disillusionment when faced with real-world challenges.
sentences.zh: 青春的理想主义常常会在面对现实挑战时导致幻灭感。

sentences.en: After the truth came out, his hopes turned into disillusionment about the whole situation.
sentences.zh: 真相大白后，他对整个情况的希望变成了幻灭。
